description: “I coded my Space Rover OPPY in ScratchJr. It says hello and drives across the Moon to explore!” – Tazhish
summary: I made Space Rover in ScratchJr, using block coding on a tablet. When you tap the green flag, my rover OPPY says “Hello everyone! I am OPPY!” and drives across the Moon, moving forward, backward, up and down like a real rover exploring space. I named OPPY after NASA’s real Mars rover, Opportunity. My project shows how coding can bring a space story to life, and I hope it gets other children excited about space and coding.
details:
What does it do / how does it work?
My project is called Space Rover. When you tap the green flag, my rover, OPPY, says “Hello everyone! I am OPPY!” Then it drives across the Moon, moving forward, backward, up and down, just like a real rover exploring.

What benefits does it have?
It shows how a rover moves and explores another world. It also helps me and my friends learn coding step by step.

What is the intended impact?
I want other children to get excited about space and see that they can make things move with code.

What tools did you use?
I used ScratchJr on a tablet. I used block coding: a green flag start block, a speech bubble block and lots of motion blocks.

How is it creative?
I named my rover OPPY after the real Mars rover, Opportunity. I made it talk and drive around the Moon with Earth in the sky.

What factors did I consider?

  • Movement: The rover’s moves had to look like real exploring.
  • Block order: I put the blocks in the right order so the rover moves smoothly.
  • Simple story: Anyone watching should understand it.
